title: Rabbi Chalafta, an Amora
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah ch. 6, section 9: Rabbi Halafta derives it from here, "and to rule over the day and over the night," etc., while Rabbi Hanin in the name of Rabbi Shemuel derives it from the end of the book. Likewise Shemot Rabbah ch. 18, section 8; and Kohelet Rabbah ch. 3: Rabbi Halafta said, "Blessed be the name of the Holy One, blessed be He," etc.; and Midrash Tehillim ch. 26, section 7: Rabbi Halafta in the name of Rabbi Ayyevu, etc. But in the Yerushalmi, Bikkurim ch. 2, halakha 1, the reading is Hilfai, grandson of Rabbi Abbahu.

notes.text: The consulted Bereshit Rabbah6:9 says “from the end of the book” and cites Genesis48:19, then separately “from the end of the Torah” with Deuteronomy33:17. The supplied compressed wording is retained; it does not mean the end of the same verse.
